welcome: A realm to explore, with no required destination.
createIntro: Choose a name, language and appearance. You can change them later.
controls:
↑ ↓ walk · ← → turn · W A S D move · SPACE jump
Mouse: look around · P: save a place · M: map · E: portal · ESC: release mouse
nearPortal: Move closer to the portal to cross
enteredValley: STAR VALLEY — a new place awaits
returnedWorld: You returned to the realm of WORLD
noMarkers: No saved places. Press P while exploring.
